people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
translations.bsb: Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there as well.
translations.kjv: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
translations.asv: And Laban came up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain: and Laban with his brethren encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
